verdict.rationale: Token2's fido2-manage ships command-line tools alongside its optional GUI, with scriptable JSON/CSV audit export. A separate PowerShell/Graph API tool automates bulk Entra ID key registration, so non-interactive scripting is documented. The "headless watcher" only launches the GUI and is not CI automation. missing for 10: explicit headless/CI usage documentation, non-interactive flags or exit-code guidance, examples of running in CI pipelines, independent hands-on corroboration.
